When fail_on_unrequested_dirty=true, errors before saving anything if any dirty package exists outside the requested set (within scope_paths if given). Returns per-package save status.","params":{"packages":{"type":"array","description":"Array of long package names (e.g. [\"/Game/Tests/Monolith/DA_Foo\"]) to save.","required":true},"fail_on_unrequested_dirty":{"type":"bool","description":"If true, abort (saving nothing) when a dirty package outside the request set is found. Default false.","required":false,"default":"false"},"scope_paths":{"type":"array","description":"Path prefixes that bound the unrequested-dirty pre-scan (only used with fail_on_unrequested_dirty). Omit to scan all dirty packages.","required":false},"dry_run":{"type":"bool","description":"If true, report which packages WOULD be saved (per-package would_save status) without writing anything to disk. Default false.","required":false,"default":"false"}}}
